def add_parameter(parameters, name, spec, errors)
  normalized_name = nil
  if parameters.key?(normalized_name)
    errors << "Duplicate parameter `#{normalized_name}`."
    return
  end
  if spec.is_a?(Hash)
    values = spec["values"]
    weights = spec["weights"]
  else
    values = spec
    weights = nil
  end
  parsed_values = parse_values(values, "parameter `#{normalized_name}`", errors)
  parsed_weights = parse_weights(weights, parsed_values, normalized_name, errors)
  if parsed_values.empty?
    return
  end
  parameters[normalized_name] = Parameter.new(name: normalized_name, values: parsed_values, weights: parsed_weights)
end

  raw_constraints.each { |raw_constraint, index|
    unless raw_constraint.is_a?(Hash)
      next
    end
    unless raw_constraint["type"] == "conditional"
      next
    end
    parameter_name = Lattice.normalize_scalar(raw_constraint["parameter"])
    values = parse_values(raw_constraint["values"], "`constraints[#{index}]` conditional values", errors)
    if values.empty?
      next
    end
    conditional_values = values
    unless conditional_values.include?(NA_VALUE)
      conditional_values = conditional_values + [NA_VALUE]
    end
    existing = parameters[parameter_name]
    if existing.nil?
      parameters[parameter_name] = Parameter.new(name: parameter_name, values: conditional_values)
      next
    end
    if Set.new(existing.values) == Set.new(conditional_values)
      next
    end
    errors << ("Conditional parameter `#{parameter_name}` conflicts with an existing parameter definition. " "Use `conditional` only to define a child parameter that applies under parent values. " "For exclusions or requirements between existing parameters, use `invalid_pair`, " "`higher_order`, `forward_dep`, or `bidirectional`; run `lattice agent instructions` " "for the full schema reference.")
  }
end

def parse_constraints(raw_constraints, parameters, errors)
  parsed = nil
  raw_constraints.each_with_index { |raw_constraint, index|
    unless raw_constraint.is_a?(Hash)
      errors << "`constraints[#{index}]` must be an object."
      next
    end
    case raw_constraint["type"]
    when "invalid_pair"
      if_assignment = parse_assignment(raw_constraint["if"], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].if`", errors)
      then_not = parse_assignment(raw_constraint["then_not"], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].then_not`", errors)
      if if_assignment && then_not
        parsed << InvalidPairConstraint.new(if_assignment:, then_not:)
      end
    when "bidirectional"
      pair = raw_constraint["pair"]
      unless pair.is_a?(Array) && pair.length == 2
        errors << "`constraints[#{index}].pair` must contain exactly two assignments."
        next
      end
      left = parse_assignment(pair[0], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].pair[0]`", errors)
      right = parse_assignment(pair[1], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].pair[1]`", errors)
      if left && right
        parsed << BidirectionalConstraint.new(pair: [left, right])
      end
    when "forward_dep"
      source = parse_assignment(raw_constraint["source"], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].source`", errors)
      target = parse_assignment(raw_constraint["target"], parameters, "`constraints[#{index}].target`", errors)
      if source && target
        parsed << ForwardDependencyConstraint.new(source:, target:)
      end
    when "conditional"
      constraint = parse_conditional_constraint(raw_constraint, index, parameters, errors)
      if constraint
        parsed << constraint
      end
    when "forced"
      constraint = parse_forced_constraint(raw_constraint, index, parameters, errors)
      if constraint
        parsed << constraint
      end
    when "higher_order"
      constraint = parse_higher_order_constraint(raw_constraint, index, parameters, errors)
      if constraint
        parsed << constraint
      end
    else
      errors << "`constraints[#{index}]` has unknown type `#{raw_constraint["type"]}`."
    end
  }
  parsed
end

def compile_constraints
  model.constraints { |constraint|
    case constraint
    when InvalidPairConstraint
      add_invalid_pair(to_ref(constraint.if_assignment), to_ref(constraint.then_not))
    when BidirectionalConstraint
      (left_ref, right_ref) = constraint.pair.map { |assignment|
        to_ref(assignment)
      }
      add_requirement(left_ref, right_ref)
      add_requirement(right_ref, left_ref)
      exclude_other_values(left_ref, right_ref)
      exclude_other_values(right_ref, left_ref)
    when ForwardDependencyConstraint
      source_ref = to_ref(constraint.source)
      target_ref = to_ref(constraint.target)
      add_requirement(source_ref, target_ref)
      exclude_other_values(source_ref, target_ref)
    when ConditionalConstraint
      compile_conditional(constraint)
    when ForcedConstraint
      @forced_interactions << constraint.assignments.map { |assignment|
        to_ref(assignment)
      }
    when HigherOrderConstraint
      antecedents = constraint.if_all.map { |assignment|
        to_ref(assignment)
      }
      @higher_order << [antecedents, to_ref(constraint.then_not)]
    end
  }
end

  }

      add_invalid_pair(to_ref(constraint.if_assignment), to_ref(constraint.then_not))

      (left_ref, right_ref) = constraint.pair.map { |assignment|
        to_ref(assignment)

      add_requirement(left_ref, right_ref)
      add_requirement(right_ref, left_ref)
      exclude_other_values(left_ref, right_ref)
      exclude_other_values(right_ref, left_ref)
    when ForwardDependencyConstraint
      source_ref = to_ref(constraint.source)
      target_ref = to_ref(constraint.target)
      add_requirement(source_ref, target_ref)
      exclude_other_values(source_ref, target_ref)
    when ConditionalConstraint
      compile_conditional(constraint)
    when ForcedConstraint
      @forced_interactions << constraint.assignments.map { |assignment|
        to_ref(assignment)
      }
    when HigherOrderConstraint
      antecedents = constraint.if_all.map { |assignment|
        to_ref(assignment)
      }
      @higher_order << [antecedents, to_ref(nil)]
    end
  }
end

  all_assignment_refs.each { |assignment|
    if invalid_pairs_for(assignment).include?(assignment)
      readable = from_ref(assignment)
      raise(ConstraintError, "Constraint closure makes `#{self.parameter}=#{readable.value}` impossible.")
    end
    requires_for(assignment).each { |required|
      if assignment[0] == required[0] && assignment[1] != required[1]
        left = from_ref(assignment)
        right = from_ref(required)
        raise(ConstraintError, "Constraint closure requires incompatible values `#{left.parameter}=#{left.value}` and `#{right.parameter}=#{right.value}`.")
      end
      if invalid_pairs_for(assignment).include?(required)
        left = from_ref(assignment)
        right = from_ref(required)
        raise(ConstraintError, "Constraint closure makes `#{left.parameter}=#{left.value}` conflict with its own requirement `#{right.parameter}=#{right.value}`.")
      end
    }
  }
  @forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    unless complete_assignment(partial, rng: nil).nil?
      next
    end
    assignments = forced.map { |parameter_index, value_index|
      parameter = model.parameters[parameter_index]
      "#{parameter.name}=#{parameter.values[value_index]}"
    }.join(", ")
    raise(ConstraintError, "Forced interaction is not feasible: #{assignments}.")
  }
end

  deterministic = engine.complete_assignment(partial, rng: nil)

    candidates[deterministic] = score_row(model, deterministic, uncovered, strength)

    if candidate.nil?

    score = score_row(model, candidate, uncovered, strength)
    previous = candidates[candidate]
    if previous.nil? || (score <=> previous).positive?
      candidates[candidate] = score
    end
  }
  if candidates.empty?
    return nil
  end
  candidates.max_by { |row, score|
    [score[0], score[1], reverse_lex(row)]
  }[0]
end

      end
      if progress && (checked % 1000).zero?
        report.call
      end
    }
  }
  if progress
    report.call
  end
  tuples
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength:, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 1, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = nil
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 167, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)

  coverage_points = []

    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))

      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: nil, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, self.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - nil
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(self.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, nil)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))

      [parameter_index, value_index]

    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min

      [parameter_index, value_index]

      limit_reached = true
      break

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)

  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: nil, scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)

  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

def generate_covering_array(model, strength: nil, seed: 42, pool_size: 50, progress: nil, max_rows: nil, stop_after_coverage: nil)
  actual_strength = strength || model.strength
  if pool_size < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`pool_size` must be at least 1.")
  end
  if !max_rows.nil? && max_rows < 1
    raise(ArgumentError, "`max_rows` must be at least 1.")
  end
  coverage_target = coverage_target_for(stop_after_coverage)
  engine = ConstraintEngine.new(model)
  unless engine.can_complete?({})
    raise(ArgumentError, "Model has no valid full assignments.")
  end
  valid_tuples = enumerate_valid_tuples(model, engine, actual_strength, progress:)
  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil? || rows.include?(row)
      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }
    row = best_candidate_row(model, engine, partial, uncovered, actual_strength, pool_size, rng)
    if row.nil?
      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)
end

  coverage_points = []

    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: nil, uncovered: uncovered.length))
      true
    else
      false
    end
  }
  engine.forced_interactions.each { |forced|
    partial = forced.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]

      next
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }

      raise("Unable to complete uncovered tuple: #{seed_tuple.inspect}")
    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end

    end

      [parameter_index, value_index]

    end
    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end

  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)
  rows = []
  coverage_points = []
  rng = MersenneTwister.new(seed)
  limit_reached = false
  progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "enumerated", scenario: 0, covered: 0, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct: coverage_pct(0, valid_tuples.length), uncovered: uncovered.length))
  record_row = lambda { |row|
    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)
    covered = valid_tuples.length - uncovered.length
    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))

      break
    end
  }
  while !uncovered.empty? && !limit_reached
    seed_tuple = uncovered.min
    partial = seed_tuple.to_h { |parameter_index, value_index|
      [parameter_index, value_index]
    }

    if record_row.call(row)
      limit_reached = true
      break
    end
  end
  GenerationResult.new(rows: rows.freeze, coverage_curve: coverage_points.freeze, total_valid_tuples: valid_tuples.length)

  uncovered = Set.new(valid_tuples)

  coverage_points = []

    newly_covered = covered_tuples(row, actual_strength, uncovered)
    rows << row
    uncovered.subtract(newly_covered)

    cumulative_pct = coverage_pct(covered, valid_tuples.length)
    coverage_points << CoveragePoint.new(scenario: rows.length, cumulative_pct:)
    progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "scenario", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))
    if should_stop?(rows.length, cumulative_pct, max_rows, coverage_target)
      progress&.call(GenerationProgress.new(event: "stopped", scenario: rows.length, covered:, total: valid_tuples.length, cumulative_pct:, uncovered: uncovered.length))

    end

      break

      [parameter_index, value_index]

  rows = named_rows(model, result)
  headers = ["#"] + model.parameter_names
  body = rows.each_with_index.map { |row, index|
    [(index + 1).to_s] + model.parameter_names.map { |name|
      row[name]
    }
  }
  widths = headers.each_index.map { |column|
    ([headers[column].length] + body.map { |record|
      record[column].length
    }).max
  }
  lines = headline(model, result), ""
  lines.concat(milestone_lines(result))
  lines << ""
  lines << headers.each_index.map { |column|
    if column.zero?
      headers[column].rjust(widths[column])
    else
      headers[column].ljust(widths[column])
    end
  }.join(" | ")
  lines << widths.map { |width|
    "-" * width
  }.join("-|-")
  body.each { |record|
    lines << record.each_index.map { |column|
      if column.zero?
        record[column].rjust(widths[column])
      else
        record[column].ljust(self[column])
      end
    }.join(" | ")
  }
  lines.join("\n")
end
